Method of Attack: Compromised source code, remote code execution in applications using or bundling the component
The credentials of a rest-client maintainer whose RubyGems.org account was compromised were used to publish malicious versions
Impacted Systems: Hosts infected with the malicious gem version
Indicators of Compromise: URL of the infected host, environment variables of the infected host, eval of Ruby code on the infected host, overloading of #authenticate method on Identity class
